correctness.rationale: Every maximal independent set either consists only of the hub or selects exactly one vertex from each rim clique. First-vertex decomposition gives hub probability 1/(M+1); conditional symmetry gives M/((M+1)P) for every transversal. The signed differences cancel, yielding total variation |P-M|/((M+1)(P+1)). The family sizes 2,q and q-2 singletons yield M=P=2q and MIS cardinalities 1 versus q for every q>=2. Direct permutation enumeration checks selected finite parameters. The proof is valid for all r>=1, mi>=1 including boundary cases.

value.rationale: A motivated complete classification of exact uniformity inside natural windmill/block clique bouquets, with an exact bias formula and a nontrivial infinite connected family where a singleton output coexists equidistributed with arbitrarily larger maximal independent sets. This contrasts with recent tree rigidity and rules out naive necessary equicardinality or graph-transitivity. The balancing equation P=M is structurally natural rather than an arbitrary finite slice. No general-graph classification is claimed.
